capabilities: Display the full file path next to the filename in each pane
Replace exact paths or folders with alternate text such as emoji
Rewrite path text via plain text and regular-expression rules applied in order
extras: The README references screenshots of the behavior that are not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian panes show only the file name, so identically named files in different folders are hard to tell apart.
summary: Pane title display plugin that shows the current file's vault path next to its filename, with rules to shorten or restyle the path.
